headline: Approved $6,700,150 for Edgewood School Project and $791,980 for special education grant spending.
summary: Members approved budget transfers and added spending across several city funds, many backed by grants. The largest item was $6,700,150 for the Edgewood School Project. A monthly revenue and expense report was also presented, with no vote recorded.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 8, 2026 regular meeting and the September 22, 2026 special meeting, unanimously.
Approved a $55,203 additional appropriation within Aging’s operating budget, funded by the Dial-A-Ride grant, unanimously.
Approved a $6,800 additional appropriation within the Special Grants & Donations Fund, funded by grant revenue for the Police Department, unanimously.
Approved a $3,630 additional appropriation within the Special Grants & Donations Fund, funded by grant revenue for the Cemetery Commission, unanimously.
Approved a $15,000 transfer within the Community Development Block Grant Fund, unanimously.
Approved transfers totaling $32,500 within the Public Works operating budget, unanimously.
Approved a $13,500 additional appropriation within the Transfer Station Fund for Professional Fees, unanimously.
Approved a $158,034 additional appropriation within the Capital Projects Fund-Schools and a $138,831 transfer within the Capital Projects Fund, unanimously.
Approved transfers totaling $7,618 within the General Fund as of June 30, 2026, unanimously.
Approved a $20,125 additional appropriation within the Special Grants & Donations Fund for the BOE, funded by grant revenue, unanimously.
Approved a $791,980 additional appropriation within the Special Education Grant Fund for the BOE, funded by grant revenue, unanimously.
Approved a $15,750 additional appropriation within the Equipment Building Sinking Fund for the DMAC scoreboard project, unanimously.
Approved a $208 additional appropriation and a $1,650 decrease in appropriation within the PRYCS operating budget, funded by grant revenue, unanimously.
Approved a $37,625 transfer within the Arts & Culture Fund for part time wages, unanimously.
Approved a $6,700,150 additional appropriation within the Capital Projects Fund-School for the Edgewood School Project, unanimously.

plain_text:
542  
October 13, 2026 
 
 
The Joint Meeting of the City Council and Board of Finance was held on October 13, 2026 in 
the City Hall Council Chambers, 111 North Main Street at 6:47 p.m. Present: Mayor Zoppo-Sassu; 
Council Members Dickau, Hahn, Kelley, Rosengren, Seymour and Tyler; Commissioners Campion, 
Mace, Maikowski and Murdock. Present by Videoconference: Commissioners Massarelli and 
O’Brien. Absent: Commissioners Peterson and Tagariello. 
 
1.  CALL TO ORDER 
 
Mayor Zoppo-Sassu acknowledged the participants in the Citizens Academy for having 
successfully completed their fall training and presented them with certificates.  
 
2.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES. 
 
On motion of Council Member Rosengren and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To 
approve the minutes of the regular Joint Meeting held on September 8, 2026 and the minutes of the 
special Joint Meeting held on September 22, 2026. 
  
3.  ADOPTION OF CONSENT CALENDAR.   
 
On motion of Council Member Hahn and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To adopt the 
following twelve items as part of the Consent Calendar. 
 
4.  $55,203 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN AGING’S OPERATING 
BUDGET FUNDED BY DIAL-A-RIDE GRANT, APPROVED. 
 
Board of Finance approval presented. 
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $55,203 within the 
Aging’s operating budget funded by the Dial-A-Ride grant. 
 
5.  $6,800 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN SPECIAL GRANTS & 
DONATIONS FUND FUNDED BY GRANT REVENUE FOR POLICE 
DEPARTMENT, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $6,800 within the 
Special Grants & Donations Fund funded by grant revenue for the Police Department.  
 
6.  $3,630 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN SPECIAL GRANTS & 
DONATIONS FUND FUNDED BY GRANT REVENUE FOR CEMETERY 
COMMISSION, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $3,630 within the 
Special Grants & Donations Fund funded by grant revenue for the Cemetery Commission.
543 
October 13, 2026 
 
 
7.  $15,000 TRANSFER WITHIN COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT 
FUND, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To transfer $15,000 within the Community Development Block 
Grant Fund. 
 
8.  $32,500 TRANFERS WITHIN PUBLIC WORKS OPERATING BUDGET, 
APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make transfers totaling $32,500 within the Public Works 
operating budget.  
 
9.  $13,500 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN TRANSFER STATION FUND 
FOR PROFESSIONAL FEES, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $13,500 within the 
Transfer Station Fund for Professional Fees. 
 
10.  $158,034 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN CAPITAL PROJECTS FUND-
SCHOOLS AND $138,831 TRANSFER WITHIN CAPITAL PROJECTS FUND, 
APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $158,034 within the 
Capital Projects Fund-Schools and a transfer of $138,831 within the Capital Projects Fund. 
 
11.  $7,618 TRANSFER WITHIN GENERAL FUND AS OF JUNE 30, 2026, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make transfers totaling $7,618 within the General Fund as of 
June 30, 2026.
544  
October 13, 2026 
 
 
12.  $20,125 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN SPECIAL GRANTS & 
DONATIONS FUND FOR BOE FUNDED BY GRANT REVENUE, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation totaling $20,125 within the 
Special Grants & Donations Fund for the BOE funded by grant revenue. 
 
13.  $791,980 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN SPECIAL EDUCATION 
GRANT FUND FOR BOE FUNDED BY GRANT REVENUE, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation totaling $791,980 within 
the Special Education Grant Fund for the BOE funded by grant revenue.  
 
14.  $15,750 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN EQUIPMENT BUILDING 
SINKING FUND FOR DMAC SCOREBOARD PROJECT, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $15,750 within the 
Equipment Building Sinking Fund for the DMAC scoreboard project. 
 
15.  $208 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION AND $1,650 DECREASE APPROPRIATION 
WITHIN PRYCS OPERATING BUDGET FUNDED BY GRANT REVENUE, 
APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
As part of the Consent Calendar adoption and on motion of Council Member Hahn and 
seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make an additional appropriation of $208 and decrease of 
appropriation by $1,650 within the PRYCS operating budget funded by grant revenue.  
 
16.  $37,625 TRANSFER WITHIN ARTS & CULTURE FUND FOR PART TIME 
WAGES, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Seymour and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To 
transfer $37,625 within the Arts & Culture Fund for part time wages.
545 
October 13, 2026 
 
 
17.  $6,700,150 ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATION WITHIN CAPITAL PROJECTS 
FUND-SCHOOL FOR EDGEWOOD SCHOOL PROJECT, APPROVED.  
 
Board of Finance approval presented.  
 
On motion of Council Member Rosengren and seconded, it was unanimously voted: To make 
an additional appropriation of $6,700,150 within the Capital Projects Fund-School for the Edgewood 
School Project. 
 
18.  MONTHLY REVENUE AND EXPENSE REPORT PRESENTATION BY 
COMPTROLLER. 
 
Comptroller Waldron highlighted a monthly revenue and expense report for the Joint Meeting 
members.  
 
19.  ADJOURNMENT. 
 
 At 7:01 p.m., on motion of Council Member Seymour and seconded, it was unanimously 
voted: To adjourn.
